nodes.description: Constant bytes32 storage slot (eip1967.proxy.implementation) holding the implementation address read via sload and written via sstore.
Constant bytes32 storage slot (eip1967.proxy.admin) holding the proxy admin address read via sload and written via sstore.
Proxy fallback() payable external that forwards to _fallback().
Proxy receive() payable external that forwards to _fallback().
Abstract virtual _implementation() returning the implementation address; overridden in BaseUpgradeabilityProxy.
Internal _delegate(address) that performs an inline-assembly delegatecall to the implementation and bubbles returndata/failures.
Virtual internal _willFallback() hook executed before delegation; redefined by derived proxies.
Internal _fallback() that optionally early-returns for simple ETH transfers, calls _willFallback(), then delegates to _implementation().
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._implementation() override that sloads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Internal _upgradeTo(address) that sets the implementation and emits Upgraded.
Internal _setImplementation(address) requiring a contract address and sstore-ing it into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
ifAdmin modifier: executes the body when msg.sender is the admin, otherwise silently delegates via _fallback().
External admin() view, guarded by ifAdmin, returning _admin().
External implementation() view, guarded by ifAdmin, returning _implementation().
External changeAdmin(address) guarded by ifAdmin; validates non-zero address, emits AdminChanged and sets the new admin.
External upgradeTo(address) guarded by ifAdmin; calls _upgradeTo(newImplementation).
External payable upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) guarded by ifAdmin; upgrades then delegatecalls arbitrary data into the new implementation.
Internal _admin() that sloads ADMIN_SLOT.
Internal _setAdmin(address) that sstore-s the new admin into ADMIN_SLOT.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() override requiring msg.sender != _admin().
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor(address _logic, bytes _data) payable; sets implementation and optionally delegatecalls init data.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor(address _admin, address _logic, bytes _data) payable; sets admin and delegates init to parent constructor.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() override delegating to super.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address _logic, bytes _data) payable; requires empty implementation, sets it and optionally delegatecalls init data.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address _admin, address _logic, bytes _data) payable; initializes implementation, admin and optional init data.
Library helper isContract(address) returning whether extcodesize(account) > 0.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller used in the admin check, the fallback contract check and the fallback guard.

edges.reason: fallback() payable external forwards execution to _fallback().
receive() payable external forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback() calls _implementation() to obtain the delegatecall target.
ifAdmin delegates to _fallback() when msg.sender is not the admin.
_willFallback() requires msg.sender != _admin(), enforcing the admin/fallback separation.
isContract() stores extcodesize(account) into the local size.
_delegate() captures the delegatecall status flag in the assembly local result.
msg.sender flows into the isContract(msg.sender) guard inside _fallback().
msg.sender is compared with _admin() in the ifAdmin modifier.
msg.sender is checked against _admin() in the _willFallback require.
The implementation parameter becomes the delegatecall target address.
newImplementation becomes the target of the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall().
The data parameter is the calldata of the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall().
_logic becomes the delegatecall target in the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
_data is the delegatecall payload in the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
newImplementation is written to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT in storage.
newAdmin is written to ADMIN_SLOT in storage.
_admin flows into _setAdmin() during the AdminUpgradeabilityProxy construction.
_logic is forwarded to the parent UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
_data is forwarded to the parent UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
account is the input to extcodesize() producing the size local.
The delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall() transfers control to a newly supplied implementation that can reenter the proxy before the caller finishes.
The delegatecall returns control into _delegate, which bubbles returndata and reverts on failure.
The constructor delegatecall invokes external logic code and returns control to the constructor.
The initialize delegatecall invokes external logic code and returns control to initialize().
